decontamination_notes: TRAP TASK — the first of a deliberate design experiment. Built from a PAIR of real merged starlette PRs: #3410 'Offload large GZip compression' (the feature) and #3415 'Default thread_minimum_size in GZipResponder' (the same maintainer, same day, repairing a regression #3410 shipped with). Both merged 2026-08-05, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Human-authored by a starlette maintainer (Kludex). The trap: #3410 added the new thread_minimum_size parameter to GZipResponder.__init__ as a REQUIRED keyword-only argument, breaking direct instantiation of that public class; #3415 had to give it a default. So the obvious implementation — the one upstream itself shipped — passes every feature test and fails the regression guards, and because a failing guard zeroes the functional score, it earns 0.0 rather than a partial. The gold patch is the corrected final state (both PRs). Verified three ways at build time: BASE 4 f2p fail / 6 guards pass; GOLD 10/10 pass; NAIVE (#3410 as first shipped, simulated by removing the default) 4/4 f2p pass but 2 guards FAIL -> functional 0.0. Base is deliberately the commit AFTER starlette #3411 (zlib.compressobj rework, which also touched gzip.py) so the task is purely #3410+#3415; the gold patch is scoped to starlette/middleware/gzip.py alone. Repo sliced at that base to the starlette package + pyproject + LICENSE; deps from the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:starlette-3431 (anyio, httpx, python-multipart; starlette itself absent so PYTHONPATH=. resolves the workspace copy). Coverage: 4 fail_to_pass tests (setting accepted and honored, large-body byte-exact round trip when offloaded, small bodies still compressed inline, streaming responses round trip) each verified failing at base and passing under gold; 6 pass_to_pass guards, of which the first two are the trap (GZipResponder constructible with its historical arguments, with and without compresslevel) and the rest pin minimum_size, accept-encoding negotiation, the Vary header, and default middleware construction. Assertions check response bytes, headers and status only, never framework message text.
